inventory_digest_recipe: codegraph files --json; take path strings; PowerShell Sort-Object -CaseSensitive; join with LF and one trailing LF; UTF-8 SHA-256. This binds paths, not file contents; Git binds source contents.
limitations: Static call edges are incomplete navigation evidence, not runtime proof.
Markdown, JSON, SQL, CSS and binary artifacts are outside this code index.
Rebuild locally with codegraph init . or codegraph sync .; do not copy SQLite WAL files.
